question: Which is the world’s largest PV Solar Park located in one of the Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhadla Solar Park.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bhadla Solar Park

 
 
• ​As of 2022, the Bhadla Solar Park, located in the **Phalodi tehsil **of the** Jodhpur district** in **Rajasthan**, India, will be the largest solar park in the world. It covers a total area of** 5,700 hectares, or 14,000 acres**.
 
• In **2015**, the project was **started**. This project has received an investment of approximately** $1.4 billion.**
 
• **Ten million **solar panels make up the park's **2245 MW** total capacity.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PV Solar Park **

 
 
• Large areas, or aquatic surfaces in the case of floating parks, are covered with interconnected solar panels in photovoltaic solar energy parks to capture a lot of** sunlight** and** turn it into electrical energy.**
 
• There can be approximately** 4,000 250-watt photovoltaic panels **in a ten-acre solar park.
 
• The inverter transforms the captured energy into **AC energy** for the electrical network. This kind of solar park can produce t**housands of watts of electricity per second.**
